name: Cursor
description: Cursor is a VS Code fork rebuilt from the ground up to work with AI. It features Cmd-K for in-place code edits, a chat panel with full codebase context, multi-file edits, terminal awareness, and an Agent mode that can autonomously run commands and iterate on bugs. Cursor uses frontier models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet) and offers a privacy mode that prevents your code from being stored on their servers.
